content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 160 posts are available across 32 departments/specialties at GMC Wanaparthy. The specialty-wise vacancy break-up for each post is given below. The college has noted that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement. Note on Tutor vacancies: The official notification lists a single consolidated figure of 30 Tutor posts against the Anatomy row rather than a department-wise split for this post. This has been reproduced as it appears in the notification rather than estimated department-wise.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Eligibility criteria vary by post and, for some non-medical faculty positions, by specialty. The requirements below are as specified in the official notification. MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject as per TEQ Regulation of NMC Guidelines. 8 years' post-PG experience, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in the subject at a permitted/recognised medical college or institution. At least four research publications (at least two as Associate Professor) in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed Central, Science Citation Index, Science Citation Index Expanded, Embase, Scopus, or DOAJ. Completion of the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research, both from institutions designated by NMC. MBBS and additional qualification must be registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject as per TEQ Regulation of NMC Guidelines. 5 years' post-PG experience, including at least 4 years as Assistant Professor in the subject at a permitted/recognised medical college or institution. At least two research publications in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed Central, Science Citation Index, Science Citation Index Expanded, Embase, Scopus, or DOAJ. Completion of the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from institutions designated by NMC. MBBS and additional qualification must be registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject as per TEQ Regulation of NMC Guidelines. For Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry departments, an MSc (relevant medical subject) and PhD (relevant medical subject) granted as a regular on-campus course by a recognised medical college/institute is also accepted. One year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject at a recognised/permitted medical college after acquiring the MD/MS degree. Non-medical teachers may be selected up to 15% of the total posts in a department, subject to non-availability of medical teachers. MBBS and additional qualification must be registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. For the specialties below, non-medical candidates must hold the following qualifications: MD/MS/DNB/MDS in the concerned subject as per TEQ Regulation of NMC Guidelines. MBBS and additional qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council, or BDS and additional qualification registered with the Telangana Dental Council. MBBS. MBBS must be registered with the Telangana State Medical Council. Eligibility for super specialty posts is as per the Teacher's Eligibility Qualification for medical institutions under NMC guidelines. Note for outside-state candidates: Candidates from outside Telangana must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection for their appointment to be confirmed.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration as per the post, inclusive of all components and subject to applicable tax deduction at source and other statutory deductions.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: There is no separate online application deadline for this recruitment, as selection is entirely through the walk-in interview process on the date and venue specified above.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts, selection is based on marks obtained in the MD/MS/DNB/DM/MCh/MDS PG degree examination. If marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam, 50% marks will be considered. Rule of reservation will be followed wherever applicable. Selection is nationwide; first preference is given to local candidates, and candidates from other states will be considered only if local candidates are not available. Local cadre rules will be followed as per Presidential Order (PO) 2018. DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest NMC guidelines. Selected candidates must submit a relieving order from their previous institute; failure to do so will result in cancellation of selection. Candidates already working in any other Telangana Government Medical College on contract basis in the same cadre are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry all original documents for verification at the time of the walk-in interview, including: MBBS degree certificate and MBBS registration MD/MS or relevant specialty degree certificate and registration Experience certificates, as applicable to the post Proof of research publications, as applicable to the post Category/reservation certificates, wherever applicable Incomplete applications or candidates without the required original documents will be rejected. At the time of joining, selected candidates must additionally submit a one-year bond on ₹100 stamp paper, duly notarized, to the concerned Principal of the Medical College.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview)
content_sections.text: This recruitment does not involve an online application process. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person as per the details below: Report to Government Medical College, Wanaparthy, on 12.08.2026 (Wednesday) between 10 AM and 4 PM. Carry all original certificates and documents as listed in the Required Documents section, along with photocopies for submission. Candidates will be assessed and selected as per the Selection Process detailed above. Selected candidates must report to duty within one week of receiving their appointment order.

content_sections.heading: GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary, up to 31.03.2027 or till the actual need ceases or till regular posts are filled, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates will be eligible for 15 days of leave in a calendar year on a cumulative basis. The contract does not confer any right to future Government appointment. The contract can be terminated at any time with one month's notice during the tenure period if any misconduct is noticed. Engaged candidates will be at the full-time disposal of the institute and may be utilised in any manner required by the competent authority, without additional remuneration claims. If a selected candidate breaks the mandatory one-year bond, they must pay three months' salary as a penalty. Outside-state candidates must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection for their appointment to be confirmed.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Rc.No.1881-1/GMC/WNP/2026) by Government Medical College, Wanaparthy District, Telangana, inviting applications for 160 faculty and resident posts on contract and honorarium basis, filled through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available at GMC Wanaparthy?
faq.answer: There are 160 posts in total: Professor (25), Associate Professor (43), Assistant Professor (29), Senior Resident (33), and Tutor (30), across 32 specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application deadline. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview on 12.08.2026 (Wednesday) between 10 AM and 4 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMC Wanaparthy posts?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post: MBBS for Tutor; MD/MS/DNB/MDS for Senior Resident; MD/MS/DNB (or relevant MSc/PhD for select departments) plus experience for Assistant Professor; and higher post-PG experience and publication requirements for Associate Professor and Professor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor candidates must be below 65 years, and Senior Resident and Tutor candidates must be below 45 years, as on 31.03.2026. Age limit for Professor and Associate Professor is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention an application fee, as selection is through a walk-in interview rather than an online application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GMC Wanaparthy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor and Senior Resident candidates are selected based on marks obtained in their PG qualifying degree; other posts are assessed as per NMC and TEQ eligibility norms during the walk-in interview, with the rule of reservation applied wherever applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for GMC Wanaparthy posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from ₹55,000 for Tutor to ₹1,90,000 for Professor. Senior Resident receives ₹1,06,461 per month on honorarium basis, while the other posts are on contract basis.
